Shipping MAILING LIST Contact Back to site Ron Fucking Swanson Super Fuzz $ 139.00 1 of 2 Select option Select option READY TO SHIP Qty $ 139.00 Add to cart View cart ***NOW IN GOLD STANDARD GOLD*** This is my take on the classic Super Fuzz circuit that Ron Fucking Swanson himself would be proud of. A bit more stern and defintely unappologetic. Started as a custom one off for a friend but it turned out way too rad to limit to just one!!! SPECS: Smaller 4.7" x 2.6" x 1.5" 125B enclosure, true bypass switching, common 9-12vdc center negative BOSS style power input and battery snap. Current draw 4mA. Power supply not included. TESTIMONIALS: "​I was so impressed by this pedal that I had to send you an email (please excuse my poor English!). After trying it out, I can say without a doubt that this is the best fuzz!! I have ever played. I own several other Super-Fuzz style pedals, but yours is on a whole different level. The TONE control is incredible—it feels so good to play that I lost track of time and played for four hours straight. Thank you for such an amazing piece of gear." -Satoru G. (Japan) "My god the wall of sound I get from this thing, f*cking filthy. Great pedal for Acid Bath covers!" -Kevin G. (Washington) "Dude. What have you done?...plugged in the Ron Swanson and launched into a fuzz orbit. As I stared into Ron's eyes the riffs got heavier and heavier and more and more evil. The orbit widened and catapulted me into the void only to return me eyes dilated and drooling an hour later." -Grant I.
